# Rename to .yml. Adapted to the repo's npm workspaces.
name: contract-validation
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  contracts:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: 20, cache: npm }
      - run: npm ci && npm i --no-save yaml
      - run: node scripts/validate-contracts.mjs        # routes→capabilities→tables→commands→events→audits
  database:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: supabase/setup-cli@v1
      - run: supabase start
      - run: supabase db reset                          # all migrations apply on an empty DB; seeds load; views compile
      - run: supabase db lint
      - run: supabase test db                           # same-tenant allow, cross-tenant/role-scope/revoked deny, wedge state machine
  policy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: open-policy-agent/setup-opa@v2
      - run: opa test policies -v
  workflow:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: 20, cache: npm }
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test --workspace workers/workflow-worker --if-present   # idempotency, transitions, retry/dead letter, late-result rejection
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps && npx playwright test e2e/readiness --reporter=line   # 7 states + stale_source
